page.notes: The right side of the page is cut off in this part; the right column of the index and the lower entries continue beyond the image. Initial A is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as "A" joined to "Bdicantes". Right-hand running head partly cut and illegible in places; the top right running head fragments are reproduced as seen. The top line is cut off and only partly visible, so its opening word is marked [?]. The page continues below this part, so no catchword or signature is given. Part 3 of a three-part scan; the cut-off is not described. Some entries partly illegible in the scan were copied as far as readable.
